_comment: GRAINS OF INFINITY, if Ender IO is installed (owner, 2026-08-21). TEMPORARY - this entry
is the whole of it and it leaves with the other cross-mod stopgaps.
IT IS NOT A GAP BEING CLOSED. Ender IO already makes these here: its own fire_crafting
recipes burn a fire on deepslate (40%) or bedrock (80%, one to three), both restricted to
minecraft:overworld, and this world has sixty blocks of deepslate under the dirt slab with
bedrock beneath it. That route STAYS and remains the bulk supply. This one exists so the
material also arrives the way everything else in this world does - out of the waste.
IN THE YARD RATHER THAN THE DEPTHS, which is the decision worth recording. Grains are
consumed in bulk - two per basic capacitor and one per iron gear, and both go into nearly
every Ender IO machine - so wherever they come from sets the pace of that whole mod. The
yard is reachable long before the Nether, so Ender IO's alloy spine starts here instead of
behind a dimension. They sit beside Quartz Grit and Spent Abrasive because a hard abrasive
dust is what they read as in an industrial pile.
WEIGHT 20 OF 247 is about one pull in twelve: enough to bootstrap a first Alloy Smelter and
a few capacitors in a few hundred pulls, not enough to make burning deepslate pointless.
Final number belongs to the balance pass (#36).
A TAG ENTRY, AND expand:true IS LOAD-BEARING - both halves were measured, and getting
either wrong fails silently.
Naming enderio:grains_of_infinity directly would kill THIS ENTIRE TABLE at parse when Ender
IO is absent (an item id resolves against the registry at parse time; measured in #270 as
'Unknown registry key'), which would take the Motor and Magnet Scrap with it. A TagKey does
not resolve at parse time, so an absent tag is simply inert - and unlike a nested
conditional table it leaves no dangling reference and no loot-validation warning (#277).
expand:true makes the tag contribute ONE ENTRY PER MEMBER, so with Ender IO absent it
contributes NONE and the pool total falls back to 227. expand:false would instead leave a
single entry holding weight 20 that wins one roll in twelve and hands back NOTHING - the
exact silent dud pull that shipped in #276 and was caught in review of #277.
grains_of_infinity_is_inert_without_enderio pins it.
